text: Hostel gates close at 10:00 PM on all days. Residents returning after 10:00 PM must obtain prior written permission from the warden.
Visitors are permitted only between 4:00 PM and 6:00 PM in the visitors lounge. Visitors are not allowed inside rooms.
The mess fee is Rs. 3,500 per month.
A refundable security deposit of Rs. 10,000 is collected at the time of admission to the hostel.
Electric heaters, induction stoves and similar appliances are strictly prohibited in hostel rooms.
